Overview

Abuja is a city in FCT with a population of 3,770,000. Nigeria’s purpose-built capital city, known for its modern architecture, diplomatic missions, and central location. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
